title: Record a local artifact manifest
boundary: The server reads files from this delivery’s allowed local workspace and records their SHA-256 and size. This does not build, upload, sign, verify a Runner, or deploy anything.
effects: Saving replaces the manifest and invalidates this commit’s existing review. It may queue an artifact-ready notification if notifications are enabled. Platform, architecture and build job are declarations only.
pathHelp: Use 1–30 existing files, with relative paths (no drive, leading slash, . or .. segments). The server checks workspace identity, clean Git HEAD, real paths and file changes. Symlinks escaping the workspace and directories are rejected.
confirm: I reviewed this exact commit and file list. I authorize reading these workspace files, replacing the manifest, invalidating the prior review, and any already-enabled artifact notification.
pending: Hashing and recording… Do not submit again.
saved: The local manifest was recorded. Review the refreshed evidence below; builds, signatures and upload remain unverified.
rejected: The request was rejected. Check permissions, file paths and fixed commit, then review a corrected request. No automatic retry was made.
unknown: The outcome is unknown. This API has no idempotent retry. Do not resubmit: refresh the saved evidence and inspect the manifest and activity history first. A matching manifest alone does not identify this request.
denied: Access to this delivery is unavailable. The draft has been cleared. Reload after verifying your account and permissions.
storage: This browser cannot retain the uncertainty marker. No new request will be sent. Restore session storage access and reload.
refreshFailed: Saved evidence could not be refreshed. Do not interpret stale evidence as a confirmed result.
reconciled: I checked the saved manifest and activity history, resolved the unknown outcome, and want to prepare a separate new operation.
newOperation: Prepare a new operation after review
